text:
Alex (Sales): Nebula POC request: hosted API keys, 48h TTL, rotation every 48h, IP allowlist, webhook on rotate/revoke, and audit export to their SIEM. Need runbook and automation by Friday.
Mira (Solutions): Keys scoped to embeddings.read + completions.read, rate-limit ~100rps, add tags team=nebula,poc=true. They want auto-rotation and one-click issuance.
Sam (DevEx): We have an internal CLI `rwi-ctl`. Example: `rwi-ctl keys create --scope embeddings.read,completions.read --ttl 48h --ips 203.0.113.0/24 --tag team=nebula --tag poc=true --webhook https://hooks.salesops.internal/nebula` Returns ID, key, expires. Rotation: create new -> swap -> revoke old. I'll add a tiny script to the onboarding ticket.
Lee (Eng): API endpoints: POST /v1/keys (create), POST /v1/keys/{id}/revoke, POST /v1/keys/{id}/rotate. Audit events: keys.create/rotate/revoke available for export or log-sink to customer SIEM. We can mask keys in webhooks and include `requested_by`. Recommend canary token and pre-warming model variant.
sec-bot: Security checks: minimal scope, TTL <=48h, record requested_by & business_justification, forward audit logs, store in Vault, enable KMS if stored. If compromise: revoke immediately, block IPs, issue new keys, notify legal if needed.
Mira (Solutions): I'll open Zendesk and assign to Sam+Lee. Sam please attach the runbook (30min) and a Terraform snippet for allowlist.
Sam (DevEx): On it. Will push script + runbook and schedule the 30-min handoff.
Alex (Sales): Please CC me and add webhook to #salesops-nebula. Blockers: SAML gaps or missing log-sink.
Lee (Eng): Will add 100rps guard and webhook events.
Mira (Solutions): Thanks — target Friday.
Sam (DevEx): Uploaded runbook link in ticket.
Alex (Sales): Perfect. :white_check_mark:
